buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Generic Scope of supply includes Training: Number of employees to be trained 2 , Place for Training RRCAT, INDORE and Duration of training 1 days. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Case File No.-DPS/IRPU/PG-IV/73509 1) Additional Technical Parameters : a) Display Panel Size, Diagonal (in Inches): 65 only. b) Pre-Install Software (OS): Android or Windows(with perpectual licensce). c) Processor Base Frequency (in GHz): 2 or more. d) Power Consumption (in Watts): 230 or less. e) Installation Kit for each panel: User Manual, HDMI Cable, Installation Manual, Remote contr ol with Battery, Power Cord, USB Cable. 2) All items, terms & conditions, specifications are as per Bid document/attached annexure. 3) Packing/Delivery Note: In case of an order, all the packages invariably will have details (Super scribe d) like GeM Contract No., Consignee Name, Consignor name, Phone No., etc to avoid refusal of the consign ment at the time of delivery. 4) OTP based delivery is not acceptable at receipt section.

5) Invoice Note: In the event of award of Contract supplier should upload Physically Signed Invoice Copy on GeM portal well before expiry of contractual delivery period for payment purpose and also Hard Copy of the Invoice should be forwarded to Pay and Accounts Officer, RRCAT, Indore: 452013. 6) GST registration certificate consisting of A & B forms shall be furnished along with your offe r. 7) Bidders while participating in a bid should submit price element(s) in Financial bid only. Acc ordingly, all bidders are advised not to mention any price element(s) in the technical bid, else the offer shall be rejected as non responsive. 8) Drivers should carry Original Transport Driving License and Vehicles should posses all the Required Vali d Original Road documents such as Registration Certificate Insurance, Fitness and etc., otherwise the vehi cles will not be permitted in RRCAT for Delivery. 9) LIABILITY UNDER WORKMEN COMPENSATION ACT: The contractor shall at all time indemnify the Purchaser against any claim which may be made under the Workmen Compensation Act, 1923 or any statutory modifications thereof or otherwise for or in respect of a ny damage or compensation payable in consequence of any accident, death or injury sustained by any wo rker or person in the employment of the contractor. 10) Procuring Entity’s right without assigning any reason to: a) Reject any or all of the Bids or b) Cancel the tender process, or c) Abandon the procurement of the goods, or d) Issue another tender for identical or similar goods. 11) Additional Terms & Conditions: a) The vendor should clearly specify make and model of the material. b) Bill of material and data sheet wit h part number of Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) number should be included in the offer. c) User Manual of the Interactive Panel should be supplied. d) The vendor must provide complete accessories to install, operate, and manage the product. 12) Supply shall be made in single lot only. 13) Performance Security Bank Guarantee: Supplier has to ensure delivery of hard copy of the origina l BG/DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract with a validity period of 39 months. 14) Note - If any bidder opts for submission of demand draft in place of Bank Guarantee then it should be In favour of Pay & Accounts Officer, RRCAT" payable at Indore. Demand Draft shall be sent to "Assistant P urchase Officer-IV”, Indore Regional Purchase Unit, RRCAT, Indore-452013 (M.P.) in a sealed envelope sup erscribing boldly Contract Number, so as to reach before the stipulated time. . 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PAY & ACCOUNTS OFFICER, RRCAT payable at INDORE . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
